data.long_meaning: In Greek, Mahala means 'Comforter' or 'Consolation'. This name is derived from the Greek word 'mahalos', which means 'consolation' or 'comfort'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the Holy Spirit, who provides comfort and consolation to believers. The name Mahala carries the meaning “Comforter, Consolation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mahala usually hope their child will grow to embody comforter, consolation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
